runs.text: Kabhi kabhi insaan apni life kisi aur ke saath nahi... apni hi awaaz ke saath jee raha hota hai.
Ek aisi awaaz... jo kabhi rukti nahi.
Na sote waqt. Na chalte waqt. Na kisi se baat karte waqt.
Bas volume change hota rehta hai.
Kabhi wo itni halki hoti hai ki background noise lagti hai. Kabhi itni loud ki uske alawa kuch sunai hi nahi deta.
Jaise kisi ne aankhon ke upar transparent glass laga diya ho... aur itne saalon tak pehna rakha ho ki ek waqt ke baad insaan bhool jaye ki asli duniya aur glass ke beech koi difference bhi hai.
Wo kabhi apna introduction nahi deta.
Wo sirf har cheez ka matlab batata rehta hai.
Aur dheere dheere... hum meaning aur reality ke beech ka difference bhool jaate hain.
Narrator sabse pehle tumhari attention nahi churata.
Wo tumhari raw experience chura leta hai.
Bachpan mein baarish sirf baarish hoti thi.
Na uska symbolism hota tha. Na uska hidden meaning.
Bas paani gir raha hota tha... aur tum bheeg rahe hote the.
Kisi dost ka message aata tha... toh bas excitement hoti thi.
Kisi ka naam screen pe dikhta tha... aur chehre pe smile aa jaati thi.
Beech mein koi translator nahi tha.
Har experience ke beech ek awaaz aa gayi.
"Usne itni der baad message kyun kiya?"
"Usne sirf itna hi reply kyun diya?"
"Usne smile toh ki... par aankhon se nahi ki."
Hum experience kam karne lage... analysis zyada.
THE COMMENTATOR WHO NEVER GETS TIRED
Imagine karo tum ek movie dekh rahe ho.
Aur tumhare paas koi insaan baitha hai...
Jo har scene ke baad bolta hai—
Lekin agar bachpan se wahi insaan tumhare saath baitha ho...
Ek din tum uski awaaz ko movie ka part samajhne lagoge.
Humare saath bhi kuch aisa hi hota hai.
Par narrator continuously commentary kar raha hota hai.
"Wo sirf formal behave kar raha tha."
Commentary itni familiar ho jaati hai...
WHEN A THOUGHT ARRIVES WEARING CONFIDENCE
Jo confidence ke saath aata hai.
Ye sentences future ke baare mein hain.
Lekin narrator inhe prediction ki tarah nahi...
Wo uske hisaab se prepare karna shuru kar deta hai.
Hum narrator ki baat maan kar pehle hi react kar dete hain.
THE MOST CONVINCING LIAR NEVER SHOUTS
Par jab wahi sentence andar se aata hai...
Kyunki uske paas ek cheez hoti hai...
Sabse mushkil hote hain challenge karna.
Kyunki wo behaviour ko target nahi karte...
Wo insaan ko target karte hain.
Dono sentences mein sirf kuch words ka difference hai...
Lekin ek growth allow karta hai.
Dusra growth ko band kar deta hai.
Narrator aksar doosra sentence choose karta hai.
Kyunki usse stories zyada stable lagti hain.
WHERE DID THIS VOICE COME FROM?
Is narrator ko humne consciously create nahi kiya.
Kisi din baith kar humne decide nahi kiya tha ki, "Aaj se main apne har experience par commentary karunga."
Ek din jab humne khud ko observe kiya...
Wo awaaz pehle se wahan thi.
Jaise wo humare saath paida hui ho.
Narrator ek din mein paida nahi hota.
Wo dheere dheere collect hota hai.
Har experience se... Har disappointment se... Har compliment se... Har criticism se...
Wo itna complete ho jata hai ki humein lagta hai...
Wo sirf un saari awaazon ka collection hota hai...
Jo kabhi humare aas paas thi.
Bachpan mein jab kisi ne baar baar kaha—
Ho sakta hai us waqt tum sirf ek galti kar rahe the.
Lekin narrator ne sentence yaad rakha.
School mein kisi teacher ne bola—
Par narrator ne usse translate kiya—
"Jo tum ho... wo enough nahi hai."
Kisi dost ne mazaak mein kuch bol diya.
Kisi relative ne compare kar diya.
Aur narrator ne un sabko collect kar liya.
Jaise koi library books collect karti hai.
WHEN OTHER PEOPLE MOVE OUT... BUT THEIR VOICES STAY
Life ka ek strange paradox hai.
Par unki awaaz kabhi kabhi nahi jaati.
Jo saalon pehle school chhod chuka hai...
Aaj bhi exam se pehle tumhare dimaag mein bol raha hota hai.
Jisne sirf ek baar tumhe reject kiya tha...
Uski echo naye relationships mein bhi sunai deti hai.
Jo shayad sirf discipline sikha raha tha...
Uske kuch sentences narrator ka permanent script ban jaate hain.
Hum samajhte hain ki yeh humari self-talk hai.
Awaazein jo kabhi kisi aur ki thi...
Par ab humari identity ka hissa ban chuki hain.
THE NARRATOR DOESN'T RECORD LIFE... IT EDITS IT
Aur editor har cheez publish nahi karta.
Ek din mein tumhare saath 100 cheezein hui.
Raat ko narrator kiski file kholta hai?
Isi liye kai log genuinely achhi life jee rahe hote hain...
Phir bhi unhe lagta hai ki unke saath sirf bura hi hota hai.
THE MEMORY THAT CHANGES EVERY TIME YOU REMEMBER IT
Hum sochte hain memory ek photo ki tarah hoti hai.
Wo har recall ke baad thodi edit ho jaati hai.
Har baar usme apni commentary add karta rehta hai.
Pehli baar tumhe sirf embarrassment yaad tha.
Dusri baar narrator ne guilt add kar diya.
Sirf uska emotional version yaad rehta hai.
Jaise kisi ne original painting ke upar baar baar naye colours chadha diye ho.
Aur ek din original canvas dikhna hi band ho gaya.
THE NEED TO ALWAYS BE RIGHT
Narrator ka ek hidden motive bhi hota hai.
Agar usne ek baar decide kar liya—
Toh wo har naye insaan mein wahi proof dhoondhega.
Jo ek baar bhi mistake karega...
Usse khushi is baat ki nahi hoti ki wo sach tha.
Usse sukoon is baat ka hota hai...
Ki uski purani story tootne nahi paayi.
Wo apni purani kahaniyon ko bachate rehte hain.
Uski language aksar us emotion se decide hoti hai... jo us waqt andar sabse zyada active hota hai.
Fear kabhi directly nahi kehta, "Main dar raha hoon."
Wo logic ki tarah bolta hai.
Sunne mein yeh practical advice lagti hai.
Yeh sirf fear ka survival script hota hai.
Wisdom tumhe reality ke paas le jaati hai.
Fear tumhe possibility se door le jaata hai.
Dono ki language kabhi kabhi same hoti hai...
Ek waqt ke baad narrator sirf stories nahi banata...
Wo unhe protect bhi karta hai.
Toh narrator har naye experience ko usi frame mein fit karega.
Koi insaan genuinely tumhari care kare...
"Bas shuru mein sab aise hi hote hain."
Wo apni purani story ko bachane ki koshish kar raha hai.
Aur insaan apni kahaniyon se itna attach ho jaata hai...
Ki kabhi kabhi sach se bhi zyada unhe defend karta hai.
WHEN IDENTITY IS BUILT OUT OF SENTENCES
Identity ek din mein nahi banti.
Wo hazaar chhote sentences se banti hai.
Shuru mein yeh observations hote hain.
Toh insaan waise hi jeena shuru kar deta hai.
Wo naye experiences ko chance hi nahi deta.
Kyuki usne pehle hi decide kar liya hota hai...
Har din us decision ko repeat karta rehta hai.
THE PRISON THAT HAS NO WALLS
Sabse dangerous prison wo nahi hoti...
Sabse dangerous prison wo hoti hai...
Ek insaan bahar se completely free ho sakta hai...
Lekin andar se sirf do sentences mein qaid ho sakta hai.
Aur jab narrator roz yehi repeat kare...
Toh dheere dheere insaan opportunities ko bhi ignore karne lagta hai.
Na isliye ki opportunities nahi thi...
Balki isliye ki uski kahani mein unke liye jagah hi nahi thi.
THE MOMENT YOU STOP BELIEVING EVERY THOUGHT
Har transformation ek answer se start nahi hota.
Kabhi kabhi wo sirf ek question se shuru hota hai.
Aur shayad sabse powerful question yeh hai...
"Kya jo awaaz main sun raha hoon... wo zaroor sach hi hai?"
Is question ka purpose narrator ko chup karana nahi hai.
Kyuki jab tak narrator invisible hai...
Tab tak uski har baat reality lagti rahegi.
Lekin jis din tum usse dekh loge...
Us din pehli baar tumhare aur uske beech distance aa jayega.
Hum narrator ko pehle notice karte hain.
Wo ego ko impressive nahi lagta.
Hamesha observer se start hoti hai.
Har illusion ek hi din mein nahi tootta.
Usme pehle ek crack padta hai.
Aur narrator ke saath bhi aisa hi hota hai.
Wo din shayad kisi meditation ka nahi hota.
Bas ek ordinary moment hota hai...
Jahan tum achanak apne hi thought ko dekh lete ho.
Tum us thought ke saath behte nahi.
Par isi mein ek nayi direction chhupi hoti hai.
Narrator aur tum ek hi cheez nahi rehte.
Aur ek sun raha hota hai.
WHEN SILENCE IS NO LONGER FILLED
Silence uske liye khaali jagah hai.
Aur khaali jagah usse uncomfortable lagti hai.
Isliye wo har gap ko words se bhar deta hai.
Har pause ko meaning de deta hai.
Har uncertainty ko story bana deta hai.
Toh insaan har silence ko explain karna chhod deta hai.
Kuch messages bas late hote hain.
Kuch log bas thak jaate hain.
Kuch conversations ka koi hidden meaning nahi hota.
Aur shayad isi simplicity mein bahut saari unnecessary suffering khatam ho jaati hai.
Agar ek din ke liye narrator bilkul chup ho jaaye...
Shayad pehli baar tum aasman ko analyse kiye bina dekhoge.
Baarish ko metaphor banaye bina mehsoos karoge.
Kisi insaan ki baat ko hidden intention ke bina sunoge.
Kisi smile ko decode nahi karoge.
Kisi delay ko rejection nahi banaoge.
Bas halka sa simple ho jayegi.
Aur hum aksar simplicity ko underestimate kar dete hain.
Kyunki mind ko complexity intelligent lagti hai.
Hum usse complex bana dete hain.
Freedom ka matlab thoughts ka khatam ho jaana nahi hota.
Ki ab tum uski har baat par sign nahi karoge.
Har sentence agreement deserve nahi karta.
Ye distance bahut chhota lagta hai.
Lekin isi distance mein choice paida hoti hai.
Awareness sirf ek concept reh jaati hai.
THE NARRATOR WAS NEVER THE ENEMY
Shayad sabse surprising baat ye hai...
Narrator kabhi tumhara dushman tha hi nahi.
Wo sirf survive karna jaanta tha.
Usne har purane hurt se kuch rules bana liye.
Uska intention tumhe todna nahi tha.
Uska intention tumhe dobara tootne se bachana tha.
Ki protection dheere dheere prison ban gayi.
Aur jab survival hi life ban jaaye...
Toh jeena peeche reh jaata hai.
THE END OF THE VOICE... OR THE BEGINNING OF LISTENING?
Narrator shayad kabhi completely gayab na ho.
Lekin ek cheez badal sakti hai.
Tumhari relationship us awaaz ke saath.
Pehle tum usse follow karte the.
Dono ek hi cheez nahi hote.
Shayad insaan ki sabse badi problem yeh nahi hai ki uske andar bahut awaazein hain.
Ki wo har awaaz ko apni samajh leta hai.
Aur jis din woh pehli baar yeh dekh leta hai ki
"Mere andar jo bol raha hai... zaroori nahi ki wahi main hoon."
Us din koi miracle nahi hota.
Log bhi waise hi rehte hain.
Bas ek bahut subtle shift hota hai.
Sirf utna hi kaafi hota hai.
